sources.note: registrant TAIWAN SEMICONDUCTOR MANUFACTURING CO LTD, matched 2026-10-10

profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. According to its site, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, and it states that its business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications. The company also says it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, trading under the ticker TSM. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001046179. No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
